mentions.name: Arena
mentions.description: Tool that uses are.na channels to 'fine tune' a Gemini image generation model and prompt for images in that style, inspired by wanting to easily tell Midjourney to use a collection of 10 images to set the style of an image. Generations are limited as it is a work in progress.
mentions.problem: Wanted an easy way to quickly use a collection of images to set the style of a generated image.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://arena.concourse.codes - Use are.na channels to 'fine tune' a Gemini image gen model and prompt what you want. Inspired by wishing I could easily tell Midjourney to quickly use a collection of 10 images to set the style of an image. gens limited as is WIP but fun to play with for a min
